review_q_rulings: Q1 (C5 = 事后改指标?): RULING = NOT post-hoc p-hacking; the boundary holds. Reviewer verified the deciding fact independently: the E-level table at §1 L30 puts E2 (不可复现) in the '无依据主张' column, but the v1.1 M1 formula's numerator is E3-only and M2's is E0+E1-only - so the frozen FORMULA and the frozen TABLE already contradicted each other before any round-2 data existed. C5 (M1 numerator -> E2+E3) RESOLVES a pre-existing internal inconsistency in the pre-registration, it does not bend a metric toward a desired result. Three additional safeguards make the boundary clean: (a) round 2 was REPORTED under the original v1.1 formula ('未检出差异'), C5 is declared effective only from round 3; (b) §8 is explicitly dated '在第二轮解盲之后' and stamped as a post-registration change; (c) v1.1's original version line is retained verbatim below the new banner, so nothing was silently rewritten. Reviewer's one caveat: C5 should carry the 'post-registration, round-3-only' label into the round-3 report header verbatim, or the same boundary-creep risk resurfaces.

Q2 (仪器未完全可信时出报告?): RULING = the author's 'record-unexplained + add guardrail' choice is the CORRECT one; do NOT hold the report hostage to a root-cause hunt. Three reasons: (a) the honest framing (§4 '归因未完成 ... 不当作已解决', §8-limitation-8 '本轮数字可信度因此打折') is exactly what the EVO-20261024-001 wording discipline demands - withholding the report would be the concealment the discipline forbids; (b) the D3 guardrail converts a one-time unexplained glitch into a DETERMINISTIC, machine-enforced invariant (summary must equal its own P-table sum), so the class of defect cannot silently recur - the reviewer's tamper probe proved the guard actually fires; (c) chasing 158-vs-258 to the byte is a SEPARATE, lower-priority investigation card, and folding it into this reporting card would balloon scope indefinitely. The 258 (5x-reproduced, cross-footed) is the trustworthy number; 158 is quarantined as 'not reproducible, cause open'. Correct triage. Recommended: file a standalone investigation card for the 158/258 root cause so it is not left as a dangling 'unexplained fact' forever.

Q3 (158/258 诚实度够不够?): RULING = SUFFICIENT, no self-exemption tone. §4 presents both captures as a neutral table with the delta made explicit (E2 constant, total off by 100), names the exact package + command, states the 5-run reproducibility, names the guardrail, and the phrase '归因未完成' is used where '归因未完成' is warranted. No 免責 phrasing detected.

Q4 (D3 只加测试不改实现?): RULING = CORRECT. For a defect that was never reproduced (5 clean runs, 0 repro of 158), 'the un-reproduced defect is not speculatively fixed' is the right discipline - a speculative 'fix' to report.py based on a theory (dropped A-arm E4) could itself be wrong and would violate constraint 1 (instrument files must not be touched). Adding an invariant test is strictly safer: it turns the failure mode into a red test next time it happens. D3 does NOT close the root-cause gap (it prevents recurrence, it does not explain it) - that gap stays open per Q2 and is the recommended follow-up card. Also confirmed D3's guard is the RIGHT invariant (aggregate == per-row sum, checked per E-level, not just total) - it would catch partial-arm drops, not just total mismatches.
